legalName: Motion to Vacate and Expunge a Conviction for Class 4 Felony Prostitution, 20 ILCS 2630/5.2(j)(3)
routeSelectionNote: The motion names 20 ILCS 2630/5.2(j)(3) in its own title and body, with the expungement mechanics at (d)(9)(A) and the effect provision at (j)(8), and cites nothing else, exactly as the legal-design record directs. No election control is rendered: the one route this family serves is stated on the paper, and the trafficking-survivor screening the record requires is a stop condition in the instructions, not a form election.
